# Series 11

## Exercise 11.1

### A

| Process | Simplified Formula | Mean | Variance | Stationary? | Time-Series Classification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **i) $X_t$** | $t + E_t$ | $t$ *(Changes with time)* | $\sigma^2$ *(Constant)* | **No** | Trend-Stationary (Raw process is non-stationary) |
| **ii) $Y_t$** | $1 + E_t - E_{t-1}$ | $1$ *(Constant)* | $2\sigma^2$ *(Constant)* | **Yes** | Stationary MA(1) process with a drift |
| **iii) $Z_t$** | $E_t$ | $0$ *(Constant)* | $\sigma^2$ *(Constant)* | **Yes** | Stationary White Noise |

### C

```{r}
t.E <- ts(rnorm(201))
t.X <- (1:201) + t.E
t.Y <- diff(t.X)
t.Z <- t.E
```

```{r}
plot(t.Y)
```

```{r}
plot(t.Z)
```
